text:
alex: Heads-up — cutoff in ~8h (cut at 17:00 PT). Quick checklist below. Reply with :white_check_mark: when you sign off or call blockers. I'll do the cut if no blockers at T-1h.

sam: Branch bump + changelog done. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/432

sam: Tagging command: `git tag -a v0.23.0 -m "v0.23.0" && git push origin v0.23.0`

maria: QA: ran smoke on staging; embed-service flakiness still hits. Failing test:
```
tests/test_embeddings.py::test_embed_response FAILED
AssertionError: expected list length 512, got 0
request id: abcd-1234
```

jen: Docs: updated upgrade-guide and release-notes. Need one quick proofread — pinging @alex if you have 5.

owen: Security: Snyk scan finished, no criticals. I added the SBOM to the release artifacts and left a note in the audit log. :lock:

sam: Canary rollout passed 10/10 in us-west-2. CI job: https://ci.redwood.test/1234 :rocket:

ci-bot: build #432 succeeded — canary jobs green. Auto-tag candidate v0.23.0-candidate

maria: I'm re-running the embed-service with the new config (increase timeout to 8s). Will update in ~10m.

alex: thx. If embed flakes again we'll hold and open a hotfix branch. @sam can you stand by for rollback plan ownership?

sam: I'll own rollback. If we need to revert, I'll cherry-pick the changelog-only commit to `hotfix/v0.23.0` and cut.

jen: docs review done, small wording nit fixed. :memo:

owen: security sign-off :white_check_mark:. No outstanding infra keys or elevated perms.

maria: ok smoke pass succeeded after timeout bump. All green.

alex: great — final signoffs: @jen @owen @maria @sam (reply :white_check_mark:)

jen: :white_check_mark:

owen: :white_check_mark:

maria: :white_check_mark:

sam: :white_check_mark: rollback owner

alex: awesome. Cutting at 16:00 PT unless new blockers. Leaving this thread open for rollback coordination. Thanks all :tada:
